sloka: अवश्यं करणीयं च भवतां सुखमुत्तमम् ।तस्मादुपायमाख्यास्ये येन वृत्रो निहन्यते ।। ७.८५.५ ॥
transliteration: avaśyaṁ karaṇīyaṁ ca bhavatāṁ sukhamuttamam ।tasmādupāyamākhyāsye yena vṛtro nihanyate ।। 7.85.5 ॥

translations.english: Your supreme happiness must certainly be achieved, therefore I shall explain a method by which Vritra can be killed.
